seo.title: Sample project: Esquimalt church drip conversion
seo.description: Sample case study: spray heads in an Esquimalt church garden converted to drip lines, with a simple controller volunteers can run.

summary: Spray heads in shrub beds converted to drip lines for a volunteer-run garden.
scope: Spray to drip conversion in four beds
challenge: Volunteers at a church garden were hand-adjusting spray heads that soaked the walkways more than the beds.
approach: We converted four shrub beds from spray heads to drip lines and installed a simple controller.
Before leaving we walked the volunteers through the controller and showed them how to pause it for rain.
result: Water goes to the plants, not the paths, and volunteers can run the system.
links: Read more about [irrigation](/services/irrigation/), see our work in [Esquimalt](/areas/esquimalt/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
